name: Section-8
html:
Proteção que acompanha o dia

Protege contra suor e mau odor por até 72 horas, mantendo a sensação de cuidado por mais tempo.

Cuidado completo para as axilas

Fórmula com o melhor do NIVEA Creme, que cuida da pele enquanto protege contra suor e mau odor.

Fragrância NIVEA Creme

Perfume clássico de cuidado, pensado para deixar uma sensação limpa e confortável após a aplicação.

Aplicação rápida e prática

Aplique nas axilas a 15 cm de distância e espere secar antes de se vestir.
css:
<style>
    .section-8 {
        --s8-color-brand: #003da5;
        --s8-color-brand-light: #0849ba;
        --s8-color-ink: #081844;
        --s8-color-muted: #5b6682;
        --s8-color-soft: #dfeaff;
        --s8-color-line: #dbe5f4;
        --s8-color-surface: #ffffff;

        width: 100%;
        position: relative;
        padding: 0 0 1.5rem;
        font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif;
        color: var(--s8-color-ink);
    }

    .section-8,
    .section-8 *,
    .section-8 *::before,
    .section-8 *::after {
        box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    .section-8__inner {
        width: 100%;
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 1rem;
        padding: 1rem;
        border: 1px solid rgba(8, 24, 68, 0.08);
        border-radius: 1.5rem;
        background: var(--s8-color-surface);
        box-shadow: 0 1rem 2.5rem rgba(3, 33, 82, 0.1);
    }

    /* ==============================
       BOTÕES
    ============================== */

    .section-8__tabs {
        width: 100%;
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
        order: 3;
        gap: 0.75rem;
    }

    .section-8__tab {
        min-width: 0;
        min-height: 3.75rem;
        position: relative;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        gap: 0.65rem;
        padding: 0.85rem 1rem;
        overflow: hidden;
        border: 1px solid var(--s8-color-line);
        border-radius: 999px;
        background: var(--s8-color-surface);
        color: var(--s8-color-brand);
        cursor: pointer;
        transition:
            background-color 220ms ease,
            border-color 220ms ease,
            color 220ms ease,
            box-shadow 220ms ease;
    }

    /*
        O radio ocupa o próprio botão.

        Isso evita que o navegador encontre o input em outro
        ponto da página e altere o scroll ao clicar.
    */
    .section-8__control {
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
        position: absolute;
        inset: 0;
        z-index: 2;
        margin: 0;
        padding: 0;
        border: 0;
        opacity: 0;
        appearance: none;
        cursor: pointer;
    }

    .section-8__tab-icon,
    .section-8__tab-text {
        position: relative;
        z-index: 1;
        pointer-events: none;
    }

    .section-8__tab-icon {
        width: 1.6rem;
        height: 1.6rem;
        flex: 0 0 1.6rem;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
    }

    .section-8__tab-icon-svg {
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
        display: block;
    }

    .section-8__tab-text {
        min-width: 0;
        color: currentColor;
        font-size: clamp(0.82rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
        font-weight: 700;
        line-height: 1.3;
        text-align: center;
    }

    .section-8__tab:has(.section-8__control:focus-visible) {
        outline: 2px solid var(--s8-color-brand);
        outline-offset: 3px;
    }

    .section-8:has(.section-8__control--protection:checked) .section-8__tab--protection,
    .section-8:has(.section-8__control--care:checked) .section-8__tab--care,
    .section-8:has(.section-8__control--fragrance:checked) .section-8__tab--fragrance,
    .section-8:has(.section-8__control--application:checked) .section-8__tab--application {
        border-color: var(--s8-color-brand);
        background: var(--s8-color-brand);
        color: var(--s8-color-surface);
        box-shadow: 0 0.4rem 1rem rgba(0, 61, 165, 0.2);
    }

    /* ==============================
       ÁREA DO CONTEÚDO
    ============================== */

    .section-8__viewport {
        width: 100%;
        height: clamp(420px, 118vw, 532px);
        max-height: 532px;
        position: relative;
        display: grid;
        overflow: hidden;
        border-radius: 1.25rem;
        background: var(--s8-color-brand);
        isolation: isolate;
    }

    /*
        Todos os painéis ocupam exatamente a mesma célula.

        Com isso a troca de aba não recalcula a altura
        do conteúdo e não movimenta a página.
    */
    .section-8__panel {
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
        min-width: 0;
        min-height: 0;
        grid-area: 1 / 1;
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
        grid-template-rows: minmax(0, 56%) minmax(0, 44%);
        grid-template-areas:
            "media"
            "content";
        overflow: hidden;
        opacity: 0;
        visibility: hidden;
        pointer-events: none;
        transform: translateX(12px);
        transition:
            opacity 280ms ease,
            transform 280ms ease,
            visibility 0s linear 280ms;
    }

    .section-8__media {
        min-width: 0;
        min-height: 0;
        grid-area: media;
        display: block;
        margin: 0;
        overflow: hidden;
        background: #f5f7fb;
    }

    .section-8__image {
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
        display: block;
        object-fit: cover;
        object-position: center;
    }

    .section-8__content {
        min-width: 0;
        min-height: 0;
        grid-area: content;
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: flex-start;
        justify-content: center;
        padding: clamp(1.35rem, 5vw, 2rem);
        overflow: hidden;
        background:
            linear-gradient(135deg,
                var(--s8-color-brand-light) 0%,
                var(--s8-color-brand) 100%);
    }

    .section-8__title {
        max-width: 28rem;
        margin: 0;
        color: var(--s8-color-surface);
        font-size: clamp(1.45rem, 4vw, 2.625rem);
        font-weight: 400;
        line-height: 1.15;
        text-wrap: balance;
    }

    .section-8__rule {
        width: 3.5rem;
        height: 2px;
        flex: 0 0 2px;
        display: block;
        margin: 1rem 0;
        border-radius: 999px;
        background: var(--s8-color-soft);
    }

    .section-8__copy {
        max-width: 34rem;
        margin: 0;
        color: var(--s8-color-soft);
        font-size: clamp(0.9rem, 2vw, 1.125rem);
        font-weight: 400;
        line-height: 1.55;
        text-wrap: pretty;
    }

    /* ==============================
       PAINEL ATIVO
    ============================== */

    .section-8:has(.section-8__control--protection:checked) .section-8__panel--protection,
    .section-8:has(.section-8__control--care:checked) .section-8__panel--care,
    .section-8:has(.section-8__control--fragrance:checked) .section-8__panel--fragrance,
    .section-8:has(.section-8__control--application:checked) .section-8__panel--application {
        z-index: 1;
        opacity: 1;
        visibility: visible;
        pointer-events: auto;
        transform: translateX(0);
        transition:
            opacity 280ms ease,
            transform 280ms ease,
            visibility 0s;
    }

    /* ==============================
       INDICADORES
    ============================== */

    .section-8__dots {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        gap: 0.65rem;
        min-height: 1.25rem;
    }

    .section-8__dot {
        width: 0.65rem;
        height: 0.65rem;
        display: block;
        border: 1px solid var(--s8-color-brand);
        border-radius: 50%;
        background: var(--s8-color-surface);
        transition:
            background-color 220ms ease,
            transform 220ms ease;
    }

    .section-8:has(.section-8__control--protection:checked) .section-8__dot--protection,
    .section-8:has(.section-8__control--care:checked) .section-8__dot--care,
    .section-8:has(.section-8__control--fragrance:checked) .section-8__dot--fragrance,
    .section-8:has(.section-8__control--application:checked) .section-8__dot--application {
        background: var(--s8-color-brand);
        transform: scale(1.3);
    }

    /* ==============================
       TABLET
    ============================== */

    @media (min-width: 576px) {
        .section-8 {
            padding: 0 1.5rem 1.5rem;
        }

        .section-8__inner {
            padding: 1.25rem;
        }

        .section-8__viewport {
            height: 532px;
        }
    }

    /* ==============================
       DESKTOP
    ============================== */

    @media (min-width: 768px) {
        .section-8 {
            padding: 0 2rem 1.5rem;
        }

        .section-8__inner {
            gap: 1.25rem;
            padding: 1.5rem;
        }

        .section-8__viewport {
            height: clamp(400px, 42vw, 532px);
        }

        .section-8__panel {
            grid-template-columns:
                minmax(0, 56%) minmax(0, 44%);
            grid-template-rows: minmax(0, 1fr);
            grid-template-areas: "media content";
        }

        /*
            Alternância feita pelo grid.
            Não usamos mais direction: rtl.
        */
        .section-8__panel--care,
        .section-8__panel--application {
            grid-template-columns:
                minmax(0, 44%) minmax(0, 56%);
            grid-template-areas: "content media";
        }

        .section-8__content {
            padding: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3rem);
        }

        .section-8__title {
            font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 3vw, 2.625rem);
        }

        .section-8__rule {
            margin: 1.25rem 0;
        }

        .section-8__copy {
            line-height: 1.65;
        }
    }

    @media (min-width: 992px) {
        .section-8 {
            padding: 0 2.5rem 1.5rem;
        }

        .section-8__tabs {
            grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
        }

        .section-8__tab {
            min-height: 4rem;
        }
    }

    @media (min-width: 1200px) {
        .section-8 {
            padding: 0 3rem 1.5rem;
        }

        .section-8__viewport {
            height: 532px;
        }
    }

    /* Reduz animação para quem usa essa preferência */
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {

        .section-8__tab,
        .section-8__panel,
        .section-8__dot {
            transition: none;
        }
    }
</style>
